spec_match.rationale: Each event maps to its spec-correct host with a live 'on<event>' in prototype check against this browser, and the page is explicit that gattserverdisconnected did NOT move — the additive-migration truth developers most need.

interactive.rationale: Six event toggles re-render host explanation, live prototype probes (two per event), and generated listener code with copy.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises host mapping + live prototype check + generated code per event; all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Absent-interface branch reports honestly; serviceadded documents the spec-vs-Chrome gap and predicts an honest false; the size-change row explains a false as the sibling feature's absence.

references.rationale: chromestatus link, spec, and both sibling concepts linked.

conformance.rationale: The suite's negative assertion (handler on device, not server) is exactly this page's gattserverdisconnected row.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP matrix both classes with autorun selecting gattserverdisconnected; without flags the absent-interface readout renders, with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features the live checks evaluate against real prototypes; zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts on each render with the selected event.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; ok/no probe colours at AA on paper; pressed toggle accent-blue/ivory.

accessibility.rationale: role=group event toggles with aria-pressed, aria-live host/probe regions, focusable generated-code block, role=status copy note.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Long event names wrap in the button row at 360 without overflow (CDP-verified); code blocks scroll internally.

openQuestions.title: Recheck the map when more server-level events land
openQuestions.detail: PR 672 makes the server able to host future connection-level events. When the spec adds ones beyond maxwritewithoutresponsesizechanged, extend the map additively with new rows rather than editing existing entries.

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle button group selected state accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: aria-pressed toggles in a labelled group; state changes announced via live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Event buttons manage aria-pressed inside role=group aria-label='Web Bluetooth events'; host and probe readouts are aria-live.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data readout grid mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: flex-wrap long toggle rows; internal scroll for code.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls flex-wrap with gap; pre.gen overflow-x:auto.

summary: The which-object-hosts-what concept, with per-row live prototype evidence and honest spec-vs-implementation notes. Verified in both flag states of headless Chromium 141 on both device classes.
